subject: MedSera discovery — model recommendations, perf profiles & next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Ramos <claire.ramos@medsera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-05T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: MedSera discovery — model recommendations, perf profiles & next steps

Hi Claire — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the concrete items we discussed so your team can review: 

1) Recommended model shortlist (for the use case you described: intake triage + summarization + coding hints for clinicians):
   - redwood-3b-quant (best latency / cost tradeoff for 256–512 token summaries; expected throughput ~120 TPS single-GPU, see profile)
   - redwood-7b-compat (higher-quality summarization with modest latency hit; ~60 TPS)
   - openfast-13b-fp16 (top quality for complex clinical language; requires dedicated capacity for expected throughput)

2) Verified perf profiles (attached + links):
   - Attached: redwood_perf_profiles_20260905.pdf (includes P50/P90/P99 latency snapshots and sustained TPS at 16/32 token decode windows)
   - Live bench: https://redwood.example.com/bench/PROF-1432 (benchmarks with the exact payloads we ran for your transcripts)

3) Prompt sets & regression concerns:
   - Attached: prompt_set_medsera_v1.txt — initial seed prompts and guardrails we recommend for phase 1.
   - Notes: We saw occasional quality regressions on very long clinical notes for redwood-3b-quant when previously unseen shorthand was present; we recommend a small eval set of 200 representative notes to validate.

4) Next steps / asks from MedSera to move to a short pilot:
   - Share 200 de-identified notes (S3 link or secure upload) for the eval run.
   - Confirm SLO target for p99 latency (you mentioned 200–250ms target earlier).
   - Identify any compliance checklist items (SOC2 or vendor questionnaire) we should prep.

What I attached and linked should let you validate both quality and unit economics quickly. If it helps, Marissa (cc'd) can propose a short mutual action plan (MAP) + success criteria for a 3-week pilot.

Would an internal sync next Tuesday (9/8) at 10am PT work for a quick alignment? If not, suggest two other slots.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_perf_profiles_20260905.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), prompt_set_medsera_v1.txt (text, 18KB)
From: Claire Ramos <claire.ramos@medsera.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-05T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedSera discovery — model recommendations, perf profiles & next steps

Ben — thanks for the thorough recap. A few quick clarifications: 

• TPS expectations: our CTO wants to understand whether redwood-3b-quant can sustain ~100 TPS with p99 <= 250ms (we saw your profile but want confirmation with our payload shapes).
• Quality/regression: that note about shorthand is important — we'll put together a representative sample. Can you run the eval against both redwood-3b-quant and redwood-7b-compat and share delta in ROUGE/QA accuracy?
• Compliance: we'll need a SOC2 snapshot and the standard vendor security questionnaire; ops@medsera.com is the right inbox for that.

9/8 at 10am PT should work for a short sync — please send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Claire Ramos
Head of Clinical Ops
MedSera, Inc.
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Ramos <claire.ramos@medsera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-05T18:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedSera discovery — model recommendations, perf profiles & next steps

Claire — perfect, thanks. Short answers and plan: 

• TPS & latency: we will run the 200-note eval across the three candidates with your exact prompt template and provide a per-model table: avg latency, P50/P90/P99, and sustainable TPS at 95% CPU/GPU utilization. Expect the redwood-3b-quant to hit ~110–130 TPS in our lab for your payload shapes and p99 in the 180–240ms range on an A10G-like instance. We'll confirm on your sample.

• Quality metrics: we'll produce ROUGE and our internal QA-checks (named-entity, factuality spot-checks) plus a short human review summary for any outliers. We'll highlight any consistent degradation patterns so you can choose a guardrail (prompt normalization, pre-tokenization rules, or prefer 7b).

• Compliance: Priyom will share SOC2 snapshot and the security questionnaire (or a DocuSign link if you prefer). 

Marissa — can you draft a 3-week MAP (pilot acceptance criteria, success metrics, and handoffs) and share it before EOD Monday? Priyom, please push SOC2 + vendor packet to ops@medsera.com.

I'll send the calendar invite for 9/8 10am PT now.

—Ben

On Fri, Sep 05, 2026 at 05:03 PM Claire Ramos <claire.ramos@medsera.com> wrote:
> Ben — thanks for the thorough recap. A few quick clarifications...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-06T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedSera discovery — model recommendations, perf profiles & next steps

Thanks — drafted MAP below and attaching the initial prompt set version we'll use for the pilot: prompt_set_medsera_v1.txt. Acceptance criteria (short pilot, 3 weeks):

1) Latency: p99 <= 250ms on redwood-3b-quant for 90% of sample slices; otherwise fallback to redwood-7b-compat for the slowest slices.
2) Quality: ROUGE-L >= 0.68 on the 200-note set and no >5% catastrophic hallucination rate on entity extraction checks.
3) Throughput: sustainable 80 TPS baseline with burst to 120 TPS for peak windows.
4) Regression guardrails: keep a rolling eval (daily) on seeded prompt/notes; alert if ROUGE drops by >0.03 or p99 latency increases by >20%.

Operational asks for MedSera to unblock pilot:
• Upload 200 de-identified notes to the S3 share or give us an SFTP endpoint.
• Confirm compliance contact (ops@medsera.com) for SOC2 packet.
• Approve a limited-data pilot contract (two-week trial + optional 1-month extension).

I'll circulate a one-page MAP + acceptance criteria doc and a DocuSign link for the pilot contract shortly. Priyom — can you attach the SOC2 snapshot and vendor questionnaire to the DocuSign bundle?

—Marissa
Senior Product Manager, Pilot Programs
Redwood Inference
